art_direction: 小新提着小布袋从秋日银杏树下走过，橘黄落叶围绕红色上衣。
composition_variation: Create a lively cut-paper collage illustration of Shinnosuke Nohara taking one confident small step along an autumn path. He wears his classic red shirt, yellow shorts, sneakers, and a tiny cream canvas crossbody bag. His thick eyebrows lift in a mischievous but innocent expression; one arm swings naturally. Place several large golden ginkgo leaves around his feet, with a simplified ocher tree trunk and layers of ivory, honey, and rust-colored paper forming an airy, tactile background. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
